profile.headline: Lead Security Software Engineer @ Vidoori
profile.summary:
Enterprise Software Security Architect with deep experience designing and scaling application security programs for large, complex platforms. I focus on reducing systemic risk through strong security architecture, secure SDLC practices, and pragmatic DevSecOps enablement across cloud, web, mobile, and embedded systems.

I lead application security strategy across multiple product lines, serving as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership, cloud operations, compliance, and customer-facing teams. My strength is identifying architectural weaknesses in mature codebases, prioritizing risk based on real-world impact, and driving remediation that balances security rigor with developer velocity.

My work spans the full application security lifecycle, including secure design and threat modeling, cryptography and key management, IAM (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT), API security, and enterprise vulnerability management. I have architected and scaled SAST and SCA programs using GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL), Veracode, Coverity/Synopsys, and Dependabot—integrated into CI/CD with effective triage, SLAs, and audit-ready workflows.

I regularly partner with compliance teams on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 initiatives, support M&A security due diligence, and engage directly with customers and sales engineering on security reviews, SBOMs, and vulnerability disclosures. I also design and deliver secure SDLC training to raise organizational security maturity and enable teams to build securely by default.

With a background as a platform and senior software architect, I bridge security, architecture, and engineering—translating security requirements into actionable, scalable technical guidance.

I am most effective in environments where security is treated as an architectural discipline and a business enabler, not a checkbox.

Core focus areas: Application Security Architecture • Secure SDLC • DevSecOps • IAM • Cryptography • API Security • SAST/SCA • Vulnerability Management • Compliance Alignment • Cloud Security

positions.title: Software Security Architect
positions.description:
• Reduced enterprise cryptographic risk by identifying and eliminating legacy hashing, weak encryption algorithms, hard-coded keys, and unrotated certificates across multiple product lines while standardizing key and certificate lifecycle management.
• Strengthened authentication and session security by leading architectural reviews that resolved authorization gaps, session fixation risks, OAuth weaknesses, and cookie misconfigurations across web and mobile platforms.
• Modernized API security posture by assessing legacy and modern interfaces, documenting risk exposure, and driving remediation and API modernization initiatives.
• Scaled application security tooling by leading adoption of GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, secret scanning, and dependency management during enterprise GitHub migration.
• Improved vulnerability remediation outcomes by owning Veracode SAST and SCA programs, establishing SLAs, triage cadences, and risk-based prioritization across 50+ repositories.
• Expanded secure SDLC coverage by integrating Coverity SAST into CI pipelines and extending scanning to mobile SDKs and embedded components.
• Enabled audit readiness and customer assurance by serving as primary security partner for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and large enterprise customer reviews.
• Strengthened acquisition security decisions by conducting application security due diligence for M&A targets and advising on remediation strategy.
• Increased engineering security maturity by designing and delivering annual secure SDLC training for all development teams.
• Enabled secure device onboarding by designing a certificate provisioning microservice supporting video platforms, Matter devices, and IoT integrations.
• Minimized business risk exposure by leading response and mitigation efforts for high-severity vulnerabilities and supply chain incidents.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Security Architecture · Platform Architecture · Network Security Implementation

positions.title: Technical Architect, Security
positions.description:
- architect on team responsible for security across all MicroStrategy products including Analytics ( Server, Web applications, browser, and mobile products) and Usher
- current focus is Web Application security including cross-site scripting (XSS), CSRF, and other attacks on OWASP Top 10 (https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Category:OWASP_Top_Ten_Project)
- designed and implemented Java-based Certificate Store component of MicroStrategy platform to manage X.509 certificates; detected and notified of expiring and expired certificates; included React-based Administrator GUI component that updates in realtime to show certificate status
- research on key and certificate management using KMIP
- implementing Usher single sign-on into React-based web application
- Member of Architecture Board's Coding Standards Group, responsible for JavaScript coding standard across the company

positions.title: Technical Architect, Web
positions.description:
- design, implementation, and maintenance of MicroStrategy Analytics Web platform
- design & implementation of HTML5-based Visual Insight product (HTML5, CSS3, proprietary object-oriented JavaScript framework Mojo)
- research and implementation of new browser based platform using Facebook's React framework and associated tools.

positions.title: Principal Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
- design and implementation of MicroStrategy Mobile software, primarily for Android phones and tablets using Android SDK, Android NDK, and HTML5/CSS technologies.

- updates and maintenance to MicroStrategy Mobile Server software in support of Android and iOS clients (Java, Eclipse, Tomcat)

- updates and enhancements to MicroStrategy build tools including addition of Google Closure Compiler and Rhino-based JavaScript parser (Java, Ant, Closure Compiler, YUI Library)

- development of MicroStrategy SDK for Android

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
- Responsible for design & architecture of entire MassTransit product code base
- Evaluated & made architecture decisions for product with respect to:
     performance & scalability, maintainability, security, cross-platform considerations, and integration with other products.
- Designed and implemented large architectural changes and features
- Determined source code standards and source code control strategy


Primary Projects:

- MassTransit Re-architecture: Redesigned large monolithic application into client and server architecture using SOAP messages for communication. Converted from simple flat file ISAM database to MySQL with multiuser access to data. Created UI that displayed live view of data via complex notification system that included automatic data coalescing to reduce message volume.

- MassTransit WebApp Framework: Designed and implemented complete application framework for MassTransit web portal using PHP and Javascript. Framework included a complete client-side library that provided exception handling, error reporting, namespace management, DOM manipulation, animation, and AJAX support. Client library supported all major browsers including IE7 & 8, Safari 3 & 4, and FireFox 3.0 and later.

- MassTransit Reporting WebApp: Designed and implemented a complete reporting package for MassTransit web portal in PHP. Reports gathered data from MySQL databases and then displayed the results using a Flash-based charting package. 

- Gigabit Performance: Analyzed performance problems with file transfers on Gigabit Ethernet networks and designed and implemented changes needed to match and exceed competitor. including low level changes to custom TCP protocol to increase packet size beyond original design. Re-implemented TCP code on Mac and Windows. Re-implemented disk I/O on both platforms to use or avoid disk caching as necessary. Final performance approached the theoretical maximum for the hard disk controllers in the test hardware.

positions.description:
Created a document management system for Macintosh.  
- Client/Server architecture using AppleEvents
- Implemented drivers for various scanners
- OCR support and full text indexing
- created compound document format to store images & text together

- Company ceased operation in 1992

Worked on OfficeVision software, specifically designing and implementing the double byte version of the notes editor. 
- Japanese, Korean, and Traditional
